task_findings.critical_counterevidence: All five recurrent answers remained wrong while self-reporting CONFIDENCE=100. The policy correctly detected a stable fixed point but that fixed point was false. Convergence/stability therefore cannot be interpreted as truth or sufficient correctness evidence.

hypothesis_update.leading_hypothesis: A temporal recurrence controller can identify stable real-model trajectories early enough to avoid one redundant recurrence on some local 4B tasks without observed degradation relative to the same fixed-budget trajectory.
hypothesis_update.support: All four observed trajectories received HALT_CANDIDATE_CONVERGED at recurrence 4; the selected answers equaled the recurrence-5 answers, so this run would have saved one recurrence per task with no additional correctness loss relative to fixed budget.
hypothesis_update.strong_counterhypothesis: The current visible confidence/state-delta proxy can confidently converge on an incorrect fixed point and is therefore unsuitable as a correctness or truth gate.
hypothesis_update.synthesis: Separate convergence-control utility from answer-correctness validation. w4 may be useful as a compute/stability controller, but no architecture may infer truth from convergence or model confidence.

methodology_note.reason: Every observed step-4 w4 decision in this run was HALT_CANDIDATE_CONVERGED, so the later V2 halt-only correction does not alter this run's selected recurrence count. V2 remains mandatory for future comparison because non-halt decisions cannot be treated as free finalization.

changes: Treat recurrence convergence as a stability/compute signal, never as truth or correctness evidence.
Keep answer correctness/calibration as an independent validation axis.
Retain model/tool outputs as non-authoritative proposals.
Use HALT-only V2 for future adaptive compute comparisons.
Expand to repeated held-out/OOD tasks before any recurrence-policy promotion.

baseline_gate.comparison: current five-recurrence fixed budget on identical real-model trajectories
